Overview of North Gyeongsang Region (경상북도)

North Gyeongsang Region (경상북도) is located in the North Gyeongsang region of South Korea, with its prefectural capital at Andong. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Gyeongju Bulguksa, Seokguram & Daereungwon Tombs, Andong Hahoe Folk Village, Pohang Homigot & Space Walk, JuWangsan National Park.

RegionNorth Gyeongsang
Capital cityAndong
Cities & municipalities82
Primary transport hubAndong Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)

How to get to North Gyeongsang Region

KTX to Gyeongju (Singyeongju), Pohang, Andong and Gimcheon-Gumi stations. Use our KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in North Gyeongsang

When visiting cities across North Gyeongsang, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Andong Jjimdak (braised chicken)
  • Gyeongju Hwangnam-ppang & Gyori Gimbap
  • Pohang Gwamegi & Mulhoe
  • Andong Hanwoo beef

Best time to visit North Gyeongsang

Best time to visit North Gyeongsang: Apr–May, Oct–Nov.
